Anna R: quick check-in on a one-shot 'claim' onboarding flow for Private CP — aim: fast trial onboarding without immediate VPC peering. thoughts?
Mike L: high level please. how does it differ from existing peering + cert bootstrap?
Anna R: agent requests a single-use claim from CP (console/API). claim binds to agent pubkey fingerprint + nonce. agent uses claim to get a short-lived tenant cert and a signed route assertion. no initial VPC attachment required.
Julio P: replay risk? stolen claim?
Anna R: claim is single-use and transitions CREATED -> CONSUMED -> ACTIVE. require outbound mTLS from agent within TTL. we also support KMS-signed nonce proof for high-security customers.
SRE Bot: ops notes: rate-limit claims per-account/ip. emit metrics: claims_created, claims_consumed, claims_revoked. cap concurrent claims to prevent abuse.
Sarah K: product: need audit fields in console: created_by, consumed_by_ip, consumed_at, TTL, and admin revoke. enterprise can opt into "team-claim" which issues a short-lived intermediate cert.
Mike L: fallback if PrivateLink unavailable?
Anna R: fallback to regional relay for bootstrap. plan to model relay capacity and cost for different onboarding rates.
Julio P: Dedicated customers: after claim ACTIVE we can optionally provision ENIs/peering as a follow-up for steady-state throughput.
Mike L: failure modes: agent gets cert but fails to attach routes — add revoke endpoint and GC if downstream endpoints not created within X minutes. edge validates route assertion expiry.
Ben (product): include clear UX: Create claim -> CLI run -> success. include email/webhook on failure. SOC2 teams will want audit and revocation history.
Anna R: next steps: i'll run a small spike for relay cost/latency for 1k/10k/50k onboards/day and draft a short RFC. Julio will help with threat model, Mike with GC windows.
SRE Bot: infra ticket INFRA-1345 created for relay estimation.
Anna R: thanks — will post results here when ready :thumbsup:
